These are three actual upstream SkillSpector reports normalized by registry commit
8b74488a on 2026-10-28, with newly retained reference and ledger context. This is a
normalization of retained raw reports, not a new scan. Original source revisions,
scanner/profile descriptors, execution timings and scanned_at values are preserved.
Cloudflare has 6 references / 664 ledger entries; web-perf 15 / 11; ASC workflow 8 / 9.
The raw normalized records have no queue scheduling projection. Contract tests add
only current freshness, their existing source revision as target_revision, an empty
attempt history and an illustrative scheduled standard-to-extended retry. Browser
tests embed the actual Cloudflare record into the existing matching repository
fixture and regenerate the descriptor byte length and hash. Other measurements
remain exactly as normalized. Coverage context is never treated as a content signal.
